  {
    "textPayload": "    message: \"<expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"content\\\"/> Well, beyond the down payment, each of those has different trade-offs. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"300ms\\\"/> FHA loans are often more flexible with credit scores but require a mortgage insurance premium. VA loans are a huge benefit for veterans since they avoid that monthly insurance and don't require a down payment. Conventional loans are great if you can put 20% down to avoid insurance entirely, though those lower down payment options do exist. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"500ms\\\"/> <expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"curious\\\"/> Would you like to know more about a specific one, or are you ready to jump back into those few remaining details?\"",
    "insertId": "m47uiyyz2odv2gxf",
